When developing the emotional heartbeat of Your Name (Kimi no Na wa), writer and director Makoto Shinkai took a highly unconventional approach to the film’s score. He collaborated with the Japanese rock band RADWIMPS for over 18 months during production. Instead of the traditional industry process where a composer writes music to finalized footage, the collaboration was entirely symbiotic. In several key sequences, Shinkai actually altered the pacing of his script and completely adjusted the timing of the animation specifically to match the crescendo and tempo of the band’s completed vocal tracks, ensuring the music and visuals were inextricably linked.

Your Name (2016), written and directed by Makoto Shinkai, starring Ryunosuke Kamiki, Mone Kamishiraishi. Two teenagers who have never met—a restless high school girl in a rural town and a busy high school boy in bustling Tokyo—suddenly and inexplicably begin swapping bodies, leading them on a desperate, time-bending quest to find each other before a celestial event changes their lives forever.
